verdict.rationale: Hatchet is an orchestration platform, so issuing scoped API credentials is a fair question to ask of it. However, nothing in the evidence documents API tokens with scopes, roles, or least-privilege permissions for agents. The closest items are CLI profiles for switching tenants, SSO, and audit logs on pricing pages, which are adjacent features and not scoped credential issuance.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
